---
title: "scQC-flow"
subtitle: "Run reports"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
  cache: false
---

```{r}
#| output: asis
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(jsonlite))
payload <- tryCatch(fromJSON("landing_page_payload.json", simplifyVector = TRUE),
                    error = function(e) list())

files  <- setdiff(sort(list.files(".", pattern = "\\.html$")), "index.html")
pretty <- function(f) tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_", " ", sub("\\.html$", "", f)))

if (!is.null(payload$run_name))     cat(sprintf("**Run:** %s  \n", payload$run_name))
if (!is.null(payload$generated_at)) cat(sprintf("**Generated:** %s  \n", payload$generated_at))
cat(sprintf("\n%d report(s) in this run:\n\n", length(files)))
for (f in files) cat(sprintf("- [%s](%s)\n", pretty(f), f))
```
